info.title: AirNow Universal API
info.description: Access AirNow air quality forecasts, current observations, historical observations, and monitoring-site data for reporting areas across the United States.

get.summary: List Current Observations by Latitude Longitude
get.description: Retrieves current air quality observations from AirNow by latitude and longitude.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude for the requested location.

schema.description: Latitude for the requested location.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude for the requested location.

schema.description: Longitude for the requested location.

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Search radius in miles.

schema.description: Search radius in miles.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.

get.description: Retrieves monitoring site observations from AirNow within a geographic area.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date/time in AirNow format, for example 2026-04-08T00.

schema.description: Start date/time in AirNow format, for example 2026-04-08T00.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date/time in AirNow format, for example 2026-04-08T01.

schema.description: End date/time in AirNow format, for example 2026-04-08T01.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.description: Comma-separated pollutant parameters, such as OZONE,PM25.

schema.description: Comma-separated pollutant parameters, such as OZONE,PM25.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box in west,south,east,north order.

schema.description: Bounding box in west,south,east,north order.

parameters.name: dataType
parameters.description: A for AQI, B for concentrations, or C for both.

schema.description: A for AQI, B for concentrations, or C for both.

parameters.name: verbose
parameters.description: Set to 1 to include agency and site metadata.

schema.description: Set to 1 to include agency and site metadata.

parameters.name: monitorType
parameters.description: Monitor type filter.

schema.description: Monitor type filter.

parameters.name: includeRawConcentrations
parameters.description: Set to 1 to include raw concentration values when supported.

schema.description: Set to 1 to include raw concentration values when supported.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.
